diagnosis.what_happened: Global directory-wide validation gates on 03_deliverables were triggered after Phase 4A-4C generated statistical JSON payloads, but before corresponding .md and .docx deliverables were synthesized.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Validation cascade failure due to uncertified or outdated draft artifacts in 03_deliverables contaminating validation suites and missing Triad synchronization.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Global validation should only be triggered after all corresponding micro-stage markdown (.md) and Word (.docx) deliverables are fully synthesized and synchronized to fulfill Directive 3 Triad Invariant.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Decoupled pipelines require synchronization of the Triad (.docx, .md, .json) before applying directory-wide validation, otherwise validation fails on incomplete states.

desired_behavior: In decoupled pipelines where Phase 4A-4C generates statistical JSON payloads first, global directory-wide validation gates on 03_deliverables must NOT be triggered until all corresponding micro-stage markdown (.md) and Word (.docx) deliverables are fully synthesized and synchronized.
generalization: Validation gates must be tightly synchronized with the Triad Invariant (Directive 3) and only run on fully stabilized and assembled micro-stage deliverables.

evidence.threshold_value: Zero validation failures due to incomplete triad
